components.css: .ds-row{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px minmax(130px,.75fr) minmax(180px,1fr);gap:16px;padding:23px 0;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #9da3a4;background:none;color:#3f373a;text-align:left}.ds-number{color:#9da3a4;font-size:10px}.ds-name{font:400 24px/.95 'Cormorant Garamond MISTE',Georgia,serif;transition:color 200ms ease}.ds-row:hover .ds-name,.ds-row:focus .ds-name,.ds-row.ds-active .ds-name{color:#b84f69}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #b84f69;outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview: The /1 resume is a six-section personal archive built on one continuous champagne-paper field with royal-brown type, silver structure, and restrained puce accents. The poem is an inset dark literary interlude. It is a distinct extension within the broader portfolio, not a replacement for the white image-led work index or project-specific case studies.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous paper field across light sections.
Puce accents and restrained original sticker motifs.
Pointer-following cat motion with reduced-motion and touch fallbacks.

rules.name: The Pink Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use muted pink for structure and active state; reserve bright pink for expressive emphasis and handwriting.

rules.name: The Extension Rule
rules.body: Keep these colors on the personal archive and preserve project-specific palettes.

rules.name: The Flat Archive Rule
rules.body: Separate sections through tone, crop, rule, and overlap; do not add card shadows.

dos: Do synchronize tabs with the visible section.
Do keep the broader portfolio visually autonomous.
donts: Don't convert sections into a card grid.
Don't use bright pink for large backgrounds.
Don't treat /1 as a global portfolio template.
